<!-- SI policy: content a specialist needs but a reader doesn't.
     Rendered separately; S-page numbering applied by wongo. -->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
removal <- data.frame(
  day = 1:10,
  nitrate = c(12.1, 10.8, 9.9, 9.1, 8.2, 7.6, 7.1, 6.5, 6.0, 5.6)
)
fit <- lm(log(nitrate) ~ day, data = removal)
```

# Supplementary Methods

The data are synthetic and exist only to demonstrate the pipeline.

# Supplementary Figures and Tables

```{r fig-residuals}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Residuals of the log-linear fit."
plot(removal$day, resid(fit), pch = 19, xlab = "Day", ylab = "Residual (log units)")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
```

```{r tbl-summary}
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Summary statistics of the synthetic data."
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Statistic = c("Mean", "Minimum", "Maximum"),
    `Nitrate (mg/L)` = c(mean(removal$nitrate), min(removal$nitrate), max(removal$nitrate)),
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  digits = 2
)
```
